definitions.gloss: prevailing view; accepted theory; common interpretation
definitions.explanation: A widely held opinion or established interpretation within a field. Often used in academic, legal, or historical contexts to refer to the mainstream view as opposed to minority or revisionist positions.

examples.japanese: {通説|つうせつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is rejected by the prevailing view.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通説|つうせつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{見解|けんかい}→見解：02743_kenkai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are also views on this issue that differ from the accepted theory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通説|つうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}される→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: A new discovery has raised the possibility that the long-standing accepted theory may be overturned.

notes:
Used in academic and intellectual discourse to refer to the mainstream or consensus position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通説|つうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ (follow the accepted theory)
- {通説|つうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}す→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧ (overturn the prevailing view)
- {通説|つうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}する→反する：11966_hansuru⟧ (go against the prevailing view)
- {通説|つうせつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (according to the prevailing view)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{定説|ていせつ}→定説：12462_teisetsu⟧ is a more firmly established theory that is considered settled fact, while {通説|つうせつ} is the currently prevailing view that may still be debated.
